contract: docs/design-direction.md: local personal observatory; project-first hierarchy; clear prototype state; native controls; system appearance; no external calls.

accessibility.evidence: Native button/input/textarea controls; task and revision fields have labels; decorative nav glyphs hidden from accessibility tree. Keyboard Tab moved Overview to Projects with a visible solid 2px outline. Reviewed light/dark text; muted light text was darkened after finding a 4.12:1 pair. Reduced-motion media enabled, with zero animations. This is a scoped prototype review, not a full accessibility audit.

responsive.evidence: All six primary views checked at 1024, 390, and 320 CSS-pixel widths: no document horizontal overflow. Desktop and narrow overview screenshots inspected for text fit and structure.

loading.reason: Static local preview performs no asynchronous retrieval or agent work. Production loading, cancellation, retries and timeouts remain unimplemented.

empty.evidence: Preview first launch shows the first-project prompt and connection setup action; sample workspace can be restored.

error.evidence: Submitting an empty task displays Add a task or research question first. A nonempty task produces a sample planning notice.

partial.reason: No real source retrieval or integration exists in this design study. Partial retrieval and connector degradation must be designed before production integration.

success.evidence: Approve once updates the pending count and explicitly says no real action was taken; reset restores the proposal. Request changes accepts feedback and records the sample result.

permission.evidence: Inspect setup opens a local connection-scope explanation and distinguishes provider sign-in from API billing. No credentials are requested and no connection is made.

renderedEvidence.observation: Light overview: project atlas, decision panel, agent rail and task composer fit; no clipped text.
Dark overview: graphite surfaces, warm decision accent and research indicators remain distinct.
Narrow viewport full-page capture: navigation wraps, content stacks and actions remain available.
First-launch state offers a clear connection setup next action without invented project activity.
